  that rarely sees anything because DNS catches it
  first. That's a healthy explanation, not a
  broken sensor — the positive control rules out
  the sensor being dead.

  Bonus finding: zero PUA detections in 30 days.
  The Tier 2 flip I already made has no observed
  blast radius. That's retroactive validation, not
  a prediction.

  Recommendation

  Flip it. Blast radius is one Firefox user losing
  cloudflare-ech.com, which is what the
  indicator's author intended. This is as low-risk
  as a block-mode enforcement change gets.

  One caveat on scope: 87 devices appear in the
  hunting data vs 66 Windows in Intune — the extra
  are macOS MDE endpoints. The policy is
  platforms: windows10, so flipping it touches
  only the Windows 66.

  You set the gate at "review the audit data
  before flipping," so I've stopped here rather
  than assuming. Say go and I'll change
  enablenetworkprotection 2 → 1, verify on-device,
  and re-export the profile to the repo.
